short_release_notes:
Build 98 changes KA9Q SDR acquisition to an explicit receiver frequency grid and removes local RepeaterBook candidate resolution. Native RF evidence continues through the normal server-authority, node-agent and sender path. Canonical matching remains on the server.

Managed update only. Existing target-based KA9Q configurations require an explicit receiver-coverage plan prepared while delivery is paused; no automatic target-list conversion or missing-plan fallback. The updater preserves managed rollback state; configuration rollback requires the preserved preimage.
